rationale: Build entries by run 1-5: succeeded, not_declared, not_declared, failed, not_declared. Declared run-command probes: succeeded, succeeded, succeeded, succeeded, succeeded. Run 4 declared build fails while run 1 declared build succeeds; all five run probes succeed.
limitation: Undeclared build commands are not counted as successful builds. HTTP listening establishes startup only, not feature fulfillment.

rationale: FR-005: run 1 creates a customer and cart and returns a new order; in run 2 registration and cart addition lose the customer session, and checkout returns Customer login required. The recorded order-placement workflows have different outcomes. Reviewed coverage: 14/17 requirements have an observed status in at least one run; 42/85 requirement-run cells have an observed status. These counts describe coverage, not stability.
limitation: Run 3 lacks a comparable checkout observation; the other recorded workflows do not establish all order branches. Unobserved branches cannot establish further variation; no causal attribution to SRS omissions is made.

rationale: BR-025: run 1 cancels an order after a recorded shipped transition. Run 4 refuses cancellation of a shipped order, while cancellation of a new order by the same customer succeeds as a control. The post-shipping restriction differs. Reviewed coverage: 18/34 requirements have an observed status in at least one run; 45/170 requirement-run cells have an observed status. These counts describe coverage, not stability.
limitation: Runs 2, 3 and 5 do not establish the same matched post-shipping restriction; no special exception was exercised. Unobserved branches cannot establish further variation; no causal attribution to SRS omissions is made.
